verdict.rationale: Wave is an accounting SaaS that could plausibly offer scoped API credentials, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no API tokens, OAuth scopes, or per-agent credential controls. The only access controls shown are human user roles (admin, editor, viewer, payroll manager), an adjacent feature, and the developer portal was uncrawlable (HTTP 403), so nothing about API credential scoping is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
